Variance inflation, per variable and per parameter

Source: R/collinearity.R
mm_vif_check.Rd

THE GATE IS PER VARIABLE AND THE DETAIL IS PER PARAMETER, which is the requirement inst/capability-matrix.md finding 3 states and the reason it states it: rms::vif() is per model-matrix parameter, and the bases of one restricted cubic spline are collinear with each other by construction. On an ordinary spline model the per-parameter figures reach 126 and a check that gated on them would refuse every model fitted with nonlinear =. The per-variable figure alone reassures without detail, so both are returned and both are labelled.

Usage

mm_vif_check(model, max = 4)

Arguments

model

An mm_model(), or the rms::lrm fit inside one.

max

Flag a VARIABLE at or above this variance inflation factor. The default of 4 is the square of the conventional sqrt(VIF) > 2 flag: below it a coefficient is readable.

Value

A list with the per-variable gvif table, the sorted per-parameter vif vector, flagged (the per-parameter subset at or above max), flagged_variables, ok (decided on the per-variable figure), and a one-line reason naming both.

Examples

cohort <- mm_synthetic_cohort(n = 250, seed = 5)
fit <- suppressWarnings(mm_model(
  mm_project("vif", "event", c("age", "bmi"), cohort = cohort), cohort))
mm_vif_check(fit)$reason
#> [1] "VIF: per variable: highest 1.00 (age, 1 df), none at or above 4; per parameter: highest 1.00 (age), none at or above 4"
